text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Trainer. 
Thank you so very much for recommending 
such a wonderful hot spring the other 
day!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"The open-air baths, the bedrock baths, 
the exquisite food... 
Every little detail was simply 
perfection—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Above all, soaking in the waters while 
gazing out 
at that picturesque scenery was truly 
sublime♪"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Therapeutic benefits aside, rich and 
breathtaking scenery 
is also an essential part of any hot 
spring... 
In that regard, that place was truly 
magnificent."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, I know! As a token of my 
gratitude, 
allow me to introduce you to my favorite 
hot spring in Hidaka!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"It is a splendid spot nestled deep in 
nature, 
so should you ever visit, please do take 
a nice, relaxing soak there."
